scope: 2026-10-16 course delivery baseline; selection is not implementation verification

engineering.storage: versioned files and Git; no database
engineering.runtime_solver_dependencies: C runtime/math library and versioned input data only

combustion.method: element-constrained Gibbs minimization with TP inner and HP outer solve
combustion.scope: nine neutral C/H/O gases; no condensed phases or ionization

cycle.method: prescribed thermal-state external branch mass/energy/shaft accounting
cycle.excluded: return, liquid EOS, adiabatic real-engine closure

physics.coupled_solver: damped Newton with residual scaling and line search; C partial-pivot LU
physics.study: C-generated parameter scans, local sensitivities and bounded scenarios

references.name: NASA CEA
references.role: primary thermochemical theory/examples and independent reference

references.name: Pyskyfire
references.role: selected turbine equations/tests; not whole-library port

references.name: RocketCycles
references.role: cycle methodology/result comparison; not default source translation

deferred: web server or desktop GUI framework
policy: Core physical calculations remain C. Raw coefficients are sourced data, not a hidden external solver. Unknown engine facts remain unknown. No project-wide publication license chosen.
